note: POOL SEQUENCE AS A DREAM (only with &seq=dream). Per shot: 'hold' = ms it stays; 'cut' = the dream crossing it arrives through (drift, ink, flare, double, fracture, pull, flicker, underwater, depth) and 'cutMs' its length; 'vertigo' = the world pulled away behind her (how far: 1.3 = the near grows 30% while the far recedes); 'tunnel' = tunnel vision (only the near stays sharp; 'focus' the depth kept sharp, 'blur', 'dark' how dark the rest goes); 'ring' = the thin ringing over it; 'intrude' = after this shot, another room flashes back for 'ms'. The last shot: the drone stops dead as it comes. 'sway': 'roll' = degrees the window rolls, 'lean' = how far the depth leans by itself. 'drone': 'volume', 'muffle' (lower = more muffled), 'rise' (seconds to come in), 'tones' [[Hz, level]...], 'ringHz', 'ringVolume', 'on' / 'ring' false to switch off.
